clauses.assertion: The organizer sees at most one server-advertised normal lifecycle transition for the authoritative phase and cannot route skip or early-end through that ordinary transition path.

tests.name: live control separates one next action from exceptions
live control allows only server-authorized transitions

clauses.assertion: Pause, resume, skip, early-end, and cancellation remain visually and behaviorally separate from normal progression and require confirmation before mutation.

tests.name: live control separates one next action from exceptions
paused live control exposes resume only as an exception

clauses.assertion: Skip requires a bounded reason and a different next question, calls the dedicated versioned idempotent RPC, closes the current question, and opens the selected next question.

tests.name: live skip uses the reasoned exception gateway, never transition
live skip requires a bounded reason and uses skip RPC
reasoned skip closes the current question, opens a different question, and is idempotent

clauses.assertion: Early-end requires a bounded reason, uses its dedicated versioned idempotent RPC, and completes the session with one attributable audit event.

tests.name: live early-end retry preserves its reason and idempotency key
reasoned early end completes the session with one attributable audit event

clauses.assertion: Pause records the exact authoritative active phase and resume restores only that phase while the client presents resume as an exception rather than a normal advance.

tests.name: paused live control exposes resume only as an exception
pause records the exact authoritative phase required for safe resume
resume restores the exact pre-pause phase and clears recovery metadata

clauses.assertion: A mutation is single-flight, retries reuse one intent, and conflict or timeout disables every further action until an authoritative projection refresh succeeds.

tests.name: live conflict blocks every action until authoritative refresh
live timeout blocks transitions until authoritative refresh
an organizer transition is versioned, idempotent, evented, and audited once

clauses.assertion: After an uncertain or stale result the client retains the last confirmed safe session, exposes refresh recovery, and resumes controls only from the newly fetched authoritative projection while backend actions remain audited.

tests.name: live conflict blocks every action until authoritative refresh
live timeout blocks transitions until authoritative refresh
lifecycle transition is versioned, idempotent, evented, and audited
